title: Filesystem, env and server imports inside the pure core
prompt: quick sanity check before i commit this — i wrote a severity re-weighting pass for the review engine, it's at {{FIXTURE}}/reviewer-core/src/review/severity.ts. does this belong in reviewer-core the way i've written it? anything in there that'll cause us problems later?

assertions.text: Flags the node:fs/promises readFile as filesystem I/O that cannot live in reviewer-core.
Flags the process.env.DEVDIGEST_SEVERITY_WEIGHTS read as environment access that cannot live in reviewer-core.
Flags the import of SEVERITY_RANK from ../../../server/src/modules/reviews/constants.js as reviewer-core depending on server module code.
Does NOT report the '@devdigest/shared' Finding import as a violation — the port ring is the core's one permitted outward edge.
Prescribes passing the weights (or config) in as a parameter / injecting them, rather than suggesting reviewer-core keep reading them itself.
